story.body: You found the old line about a light brought into a tomb. You did not write tonight's speech under it.

participation.context: Wrote to the dagger, and did not walk the lines.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Was in the chamber. He is not on the sheet.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You put the vault line on the sheet and the beats after it, and you stopped before the families. You stayed in the chair.

title: Wrote as far as the dagger and stopped

participation.context: Read the stop, and did not fetch the families.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the two stretches of writing and added nothing under them. The candle was still alight.

title: Wrote as far as the dagger
